title: Aureline M5 correction-lane queue
description: Canonical per-domain correction-lane queue minted by the first implement lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. Names the correction scope a supported line resolves its post-stable triage from — a queued protected-path regression, a recorded backport decision, or a published correction report — and binds the resolved line identity, the queued-regression ledger, the rollback-target reference, the correction-packet state, the backport-decision state, the delayed-breadth reference, and the last correction revision so claim publication can prove which regression is queued for correction, which breadth work is delayed while it stays open, and that every delayed-breadth claim is bound to a recorded override or claim-narrowing action rather than to hand-edited prose. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, help, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's correction queue by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
